item.title: "We're always encouraged from home. From my Mum and my Dad"
item.description: It is a sport she has loved from a very young age and with several members of her extended family having done likewise in the past, Rachel Dwyer is embracing life as a Gaelic footballer with Kerry.

item.title: Cunningham steps down as St Brigid's manager
item.description: Anthony Cunningham has stepped down from his post as St Brigid's senior football manager after a second stint in charge of the Roscommon giants.

item.title: Nenagh CBS edge St Flannan's College, Ennis to claim second Dr Harty Cup
item.description: Nenagh CBS are Dr Harty Cup champions for the second time in three seasons after a 0-20 to 0-18 victory over St Flannan's College, Ennis at Zimmer Biomet Páirc Chíosóg this afternoon.

item.title: Donegal and Sligo cruise to second Allianz HL wins
item.description: Donegal were in ruthless form as they handed Fermanagh a 2-35 to 0-9 in Letterkenny this afternoon to make it two wins from two in Division 3 of the Allianz Hurling League.

item.title: Down, Wexford and Carlow secure second Allianz FL victories
item.description: Shane Annett sent over a late free as Down edged Limerick by 0-18 to 1-14 in Rathkeale for their second win in as many games in Division 3 of the Allianz Football League.

item.title: Dublin bounce back from opening loss to Clare with 14-point win over Kildare
item.description: Dublin dished out a 14-point defeat to Kildare this evening to get up and running in Division 1B of the Allianz Hurling League.

item.title: Derry edge Tyrone to end 13-game winless run while Kildare's goals slump Offaly to second loss
item.description: Derry bounced back from their opening round loss to Meath last weekend by recording a 1-15 to 1-12 win over Tyrone this evening to get on the board in Division 2 of the Allianz Football League.

item.title: Watch: Hayes nets twice late on as Rebels inflict Galway with second league defeat
item.description: Brian Hayes struck two goals in the closing 10 minutes of normal time for Cork to edge a 2-20 to 1-21 victory over Galway at Pearse Stadium this evening.

item.title: Finnerty's free at the death sees Galway snatch both points in Armagh
item.description: Galway got up and running in Division 1 of the Allianz Football League with a hard-fought 3-12 to 0-20 win over Armagh at the Box-It Athletic Grounds this evening.
